purpose: Implement the first Company OS vertical slice: a server-authoritative staff capabilities contract and make the existing staff entry consume that contract without creating a second staff-auth system or changing production infrastructure.
requiredInvariants: The endpoint is read-only and derives authority only from active server-side staff assignments and existing role permission ceilings.
The endpoint creates no staff access request, grant, session, role, tenant, organization, capability or database record.
No client-selected role, tenant, scope, cookie or presentation role can expand authority.
Staff access fails closed without an active staff assignment and verified MFA.
The web staff entry stops computing staff authority from assignment arrays and consumes the server-authoritative capabilities contract instead.
No database schema, migration, production Caddy, DNS, Compose, secret or control-host change is included in F1.
The follow-up implementation branch cannot edit this scope manifest, the autopilot guard, current serialized IR-10.4 authority, or unrelated platform code.
Merge, CI and image build are not production deployment evidence.
acceptance: GET /staff/capabilities/me returns identity, active assignments, roles, deduplicated capability ceiling, workspaces, authentication assurance and active privileged-session metadata without exposing access tokens.
Owner, non-owner, multi-role, no-assignment and MFA-failure cases are covered by focused tests.
Direct URL access and presentation-role manipulation cannot increase server permissions.
No new recurring cost is introduced.
